chat_history.description: How long the assistant's conversations are kept.

inline_presets.description: Presets of the inline AI bar; `None` = the built-in ones.

max_tokens.description: Limit of answer tokens; `None` = the model's default.

meeting_template.description: Instruction of „Besprechung zusammenfassen“; `None` = the built-in one.

monthly_cost_limit_usd.description: Monthly cost limit in USD; warns at 80 %, blocks at 100 % unless overridden.

streaming.description: Show answers while they are generated.

AiPreset.description: A preset of the inline AI bar.

bypass_proxy.description: Connect directly instead of through the proxy of Settings → Netzwerk (default for providers on this machine).

id.description: Stable id (`[a-z0-9-]`): referenced by the tiers and the credential store.

local.description: Runs on this machine or in the own network: may receive content marked private (`#privat`, Settings → Datenschutz „Nur lokal“). Its requests cost nothing.

models.description: Model (Azure: deployment) names added by hand, for providers that do not list theirs.

accent.description: `theme` (the color theme's own accent), a preset name (`indigo`, `blue`, …) or `#rrggbb`.

custom_themes.description: Themes made in Settings → Darstellung or imported from a theme file.

custom_titlebar.description: Windows: own title bar (the tabs sit at the top edge, own window buttons) instead of the system one. Takes effect at the next start.

startup_animation.description: The animated logo while the app starts.

theme_dark.description: Color theme shown in dark mode.

theme_light.description: Color theme shown in light mode: a built-in id (`annalo-light`, `nord-light`, …) or the id of a custom theme. Unknown ids show the default theme.

window_effect.description: Backdrop of the window on Windows 11 (Mica or Acrylic). Off by default: behind a bright desktop it washes out the sidebar (older settings are switched off once, see `Database::migrate_appearance_defaults`). Settings before 1.6 stored `mica: bool`, which becomes this when they are loaded.

window_opacity.description: How much the theme's background covers the backdrop, in percent ([`WINDOW_OPACITY_MIN`]–100; at 100 the backdrop is not visible).

local_latest_only.description: The destinations replace the local folder: once every switched-on destination has the newest backup, the local folder keeps only that one.

BalancePrefs.description: Settings of the balance and the vacation account (`time.balance`).

carry_over.description: Days carried over from the previous year.

opening_hours.description: Balance on the start day (hours, may be negative).

start.description: First day the balance counts; `None`: 1 January of the current year.

state.description: State for public holidays (`BY`, `NW`, …); empty: none.

weekday_hours.description: Target hours Monday..Sunday; empty: the daily target on the workdays.

Board.description: One start page („Heute“, „Projekte“, …), shown as a tab.

BriefingMode.description: When the briefing shows up by itself.

oneOf.description: Opens with the first start of a workday.
A desktop notification that opens it.
Only when opened (palette, ribbon, Heute, tray); also an unknown mode.

BriefingSection.description: One section with its switch; the list order is the order on the page.

notify_time.description: `HH:MM` of the notification; empty = at the first start of the day.

prep_auto.description: „Besprechung vorbereiten“ by itself before meetings with at least two attendees.

prep_minutes.description: Minutes before the start the preparation is written (5 to 240).

block_minutes.description: Length of a block dropped into the Kalender (minutes, 15–240 on the 15-minute grid).

blocks_outlook.description: Write focus blocks to the default Outlook calendar („Fokusblöcke in Outlook eintragen“).

meeting_links.description: Look for a Teams/Zoom/Webex link in the appointment text (only the link is kept).

outlook.description: Read Outlook Classic (Windows): the calendars selected in `outlook_calendars`.

outlook_calendars.description: The Outlook calendars chosen once („Kalender auswählen“); the default calendar is always the first, with the source id `outlook`.

outlook_color.description: Color of the default calendar (also kept in its entry of `outlook_calendars`).

outlook_recipients.description: People (names or addresses) whose default calendar discovery opens by name.

past_days.description: Window of a sync: days back and ahead of today.

private_details.description: Keep subject, place and attendees of private appointments (otherwise „Privater Termin“).

auto_hide_ms.description: Hide the window this long after „Gespeichert in …“ (0–10000 ms).

default_target.description: Where a capture goes when the window opens.

inbox_title.description: Title of the page that collects captures with a timestamp.

meeting_target.description: Offer the meeting running now (or started less than 15 minutes ago) as target.

selection_shortcut.description: Global shortcut „Auswahl übernehmen“: opens quick capture with the selection (Linux) or the clipboard text; `""` = off.

CustomTheme.description: A color theme made by the user.

dark.description: Shown in dark mode (and listed with the dark themes).

id.description: `custom-…`; assigned when saved if missing, foreign or taken.

notes.description: Texts of the „Notiz“ widgets, by widget id.

version.description: 3 since 1.7 (widgets of any registered kind are kept), 2 since 1.6 (boards in a grid); 0 before.

widgets.description: Before 1.6: the one widget list (`None`: the start page was never saved) …

Destination.description: One further folder for backups (Settings → Sicherung → „Weitere Sicherungsziele“).

attachments.description: Also copy the attachments folder (images, drawings, files), incrementally.

id.description: Stable id (derived from the path when empty).

keep_days.description: Backups older than this many days are deleted as well; 0 = only `keep` counts.

markdown.description: Also copy the Markdown copy (only when it is switched on).

path.description: Folder as the user entered it (UNC paths keep their backslashes).

auto_pair.description: Typing an opening bracket inserts the closing one.

autosave_ms.description: Autosave delay after the last change (250–3000 ms).

default_icon.description: Icon of new pages (Lucide name); `None` = none.

duplicate_hints.description: „Ähnliche Seite“ hint in the page header.

hover_preview.description: Preview of a linked page when hovering a `[[link]]`.

inbox_title.description: Title of the page that collects new pages with [`NewPageLocation::Inbox`].

link_suggestions.description: „Nicht verlinkte Erwähnungen“ in the links panel.

mention_hints.description: Dotted underline under unlinked page titles in the editor (click links them).

scroll_outline.description: Heading markers at the right edge of a page.

tab_size.description: Spaces per Tab in code blocks (2–8).

tag_suggestions.description: Tag suggestions under the page properties.

folder.description: Folder path from the top level, `Kunden/X`.

rules.description: In order: the first matching rule wins.

types.description: Per type; a missing type uses its defaults.

GitSyncSettings.description: Settings of the Git sync. The access token is not part of it; the desktop shell keeps it in the OS credential store.

include_database.description: Also commit the latest database backup as `annalo-workspace.db`.

sync_settings.description: Also sync the settings (no secrets, nothing machine-specific) as `settings.json`, merged per setting (see [`crate::settings_sync`]).

Granularity.description: Date subfolders below a type's root (`Series`: meetings by their subject instead).

IcsKind.description: Where an ICS source comes from.

oneOf.description: A subscription URL; the URL (it may carry a secret token) lives in the credential store.
A local `.ics` file, read again on every sync.

path.description: The file of a file source (empty for URL sources: their URL is a secret).

tick_done_tasks.description: Tick a task naming an issue once the issue is done in Jira.

JiraSite.description: A Jira site. Its token lives in the credential store (`jira-<id>`), never here.

allow_writes.description: The assistant may comment on issues and change their status (each after a confirmation).

email.description: Cloud: the e-mail of the Atlassian account (with the API token as password).

log_work.description: „Arbeit auch in Jira protokollieren“: a booking with an issue key posts a worklog.

LegacyWidget.description: A widget of the start page before 1.6 (one list, three widths). The start page moves the list onto a board of the grid ([`Dashboard::boards`]) with the same widgets.

kind.description: One of [`LEGACY_WIDGET_KINDS`]; unknown kinds are dropped by [`Dashboard::normalized`].

oneOf.description: A program, started directly.
Unknown kinds (e.g. from a newer version) open like a link.

language.description: The chosen display language; [`LocalePrefs::lang`] is the one in effect.

number_format.description: Decimal comma (28,00) or point (28.00); `None`: as the display language writes it.

default_action.description: What the dialog offers first: `task`, `note` or `both`.

notes_parent.description: Top-level page below which mail notes are created.

own_addresses.description: The user's own e-mail addresses and names: left out of the recipients of a follow-up mail (besides Outlook's signed-in account).

private_notes.description: Mail notes get the first privacy marker as tag, so the assistant keeps them on the local model.

save_attachments.description: Attachments are ticked when the dialog opens.

shortcut.description: Global shortcut of „Aktuelle E-Mail übernehmen“ (`""` = off, the default).

profiles.description: The profiles; the one with id `standard` is the default and always exists.

routes.description: Service ([`Service::key`], or its group: `ai`, `jira`, `ics`) → profile id. Services without an entry use the default profile.

daily_folder.description: Top-level page that holds the daily notes.

trash_retention_days.description: Days pages stay in the trash (7–365).

version_interval_minutes.description: Minutes between two automatic version snapshots of a page (5–60).

day_review.description: „Tagesrückblick ansehen“ once a workday at `day_review_time` (off by default).

day_review_time.description: `HH:MM` (local time) of the day review reminder.

late_timer.description: Reminder when a timer still runs after 20:00.

task_due.description: Tasks due today, from 09:00 on a day (with „Erledigt“, „Schlummern“ and „Öffnen“).

week_proposal.description: „Woche vorschlagen“ on the last workday of the week from 14:00 when days are open.

OnboardingState.description: Settings part: which intro was completed and when (RFC 3339, UTC).

OutlookCalendar.description: A selected (or once selected) Outlook calendar in the settings.

booking.description: „Für Buchungsvorschläge verwenden“: its meetings go into the week proposal, the day review and the quick capture's „Jetzt“.

default.description: The default calendar of the profile.

free_busy.description: Only free/busy times can be read (no subjects).

id.description: Source id: `outlook` for the default calendar, else `outlook:<hash>`.

recipient.description: Name or address of the person whose default calendar this is (opened by name, or read as free/busy when the folder itself cannot be opened).

OutlookKind.description: Where an Outlook calendar lives, as far as it matters for Arcalo.

oneOf.description: The user's own mailbox (default calendar, its sub-calendars, a second own account).
A PST file or another store outside Exchange (IMAP, internet calendars).
Another mailbox in the profile: a shared or team mailbox, a delegate's mailbox.
A colleague's calendar opened in the navigation pane or by name.
A room calendar.
A Microsoft 365 group calendar.

PriceRule.description: One row of the editable price table (Settings → KI → Preise): per 1M input/output tokens in USD, for a model name (`*` at the end = prefix) on one provider or on any (`""`).

local_only.description: Every request goes to the local model.

read_open_page.description: The assistant sees the open page.

oneOf.description: LiteLLM proxy: `<root>/v1/…`, bearer token, cost in a response header.
Azure OpenAI: `<endpoint>/openai/deployments/<deployment>/…?api-version=…` with an `api-key` header; the model name is the deployment name.
Ollama: OpenAI-compatible `<root>/v1/…`, native `/api/tags` and `/api/pull`, no key.
Any OpenAI-compatible API; the base URL includes the version (`…/v1`). Unknown kinds (from a newer version) load as this.
Always connect directly.
The operating system's settings (WinINet on Windows, environment elsewhere).
Proxy auto-config; answers evaluated by the UI.

ProxyProfile.description: A named way out („Firma“, „VPN“, „Direkt“): proxy, exceptions, extra root CA and timeouts.

connect_timeout_secs.description: Connect timeout in seconds (and the total timeout of tests and tool requests).

extra_ca_path.description: PEM (one or more certificates) or DER file of additional root CAs.

http_proxy.description: `host:port` or a URL; used for `http://` targets.

https_proxy.description: Used for `https://` targets; empty = the HTTP proxy.

id.description: `[a-z0-9-]`, stable (routes and the credential account refer to it); `standard` is the default profile.

legacy_accept_invalid_certs.description: Accept any certificate: the global switch of 1.9 and older, kept for the profiles that had it („unsicher“) until it is converted into trusted servers.

pac_results.description: `FindProxyForURL` answers per host (`*` = default), filled by the UI.

pac_url.description: `http(s)://` or `file://` address of a PAC script.

proxy_user.description: User name for the proxy; the password is in the credential store ([`password_account`]).

read_timeout_secs.description: Read timeout in seconds; 0 = the service's own (downloads: 60 s, others none).

socks_proxy.description: `host:port` or `socks5://host:port`; used when no HTTP(S) proxy is set.

QuickLink.description: A link in the ribbon: a web address, `mailto:`, a local folder or file, a program, or a group of such links (shown as one icon that opens a list of them).

color.description: A group's icon color (`blau`, `grün`, …; empty = like the other ribbon icons).

items.description: A group's links and programs, in order (groups do not nest).

kind.description: Link, program or group; links saved before groups existed have none (= link).

url.description: The address or path (empty for a group).

Rounding.description: Rounding of booked durations (bookings and timer stops).

min_minutes.description: Bookings shorter than this are raised to it (0 = off).

local_provider.description: Provider ids of the tiers; `""` = the first provider (settings of older versions).

reasoning_threshold.description: Scores at or above this go to the reasoning tier.

standard_threshold.description: Scores at or above this go to the standard tier.

oneOf.description: `key` is the tag (without `#`; subtags `key/…` match too).
Frontmatter `key: value` (an empty value: the property is set).
`key` is a Jira project key (`jira:` property or a title starting with `ABC-12`).
`key` is a Netzplan (`vorgang: NP-1/0010` or `netzplan: NP-1`).
The title starts with `key`.

SavedQuery.description: A saved JQL search: its issues are synced with the default search and it can be shown as a „Jira-Abfrage“ widget.

oneOf.description: „Für alle Arbeitsbereiche“: the shared value.
„Nur dieser Arbeitsbereich“: the workspace's own value.

SiteKind.description: Cloud (REST v3, e-mail and API token) or Server/Data Center (REST v2, personal access token).

minimized.description: Start hidden in the tray (minimized without a tray).

oneOf.description: After every backup (daily, and „Jetzt sichern“).
Every hour (the mirror is refreshed first).

ThemeColors.description: The main colors of a custom theme; the UI derives the remaining tokens (hover, strong borders, soft tints, shadows) from them.

critical.description: Consumed share of the plan that raises a critical alert (e.g. 0.9).

warning.description: Consumed share of the plan that raises a warning (e.g. 0.75).

balance.description: Overtime balance, vacation account and public holidays.

cats_decimal.description: Decimal separator of the hours in the CATS file and „Für CATS kopieren“.

default_leistungsart.description: Leistungsart used when a booking has none, per Netzplan number (`NP-8801` → `DEV`).

enabled.description: „Zeiterfassung verwenden“: off hides the timesheet, projects and their commands.

export_file_pattern.description: Default file name of exports without extension; `{von}`, `{bis}`, `{format}`, `{kw}`, `{pernr}`.

work_start.description: Start of the working hours (local `HH:MM`): the free slots of „Im Kalender planen…“ lie inside `work_start..work_end`.

TrustedHost.description: „Diesem Server vertrauen“: a host whose leaf certificate is accepted when its SHA-256 matches (and only then: a different certificate is rejected even if a CA vouches for it).

host.description: Host name or IP address, lower case, without port.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the leaf certificate (DER), 64 hex digits.

spki_sha256.description: SHA-256 of its public key (`SubjectPublicKeyInfo`), Base64; Git pins with it.

subject.description: Subject (CN) and expiry, for the list.

folder.description: Root folder (a path `A/B` is allowed); empty: the default name (journal and mail: Settings → Notizen / E-Mail).

UpdateMode.description: What the app does about new versions.

oneOf.description: Check, download in the background, install when the app quits.
Check and show the new version; installing needs a click.
No automatic checks (a policy: no checks at all).

allow_github_fallback.description: Ask GitHub when the own source fails.

restore_session.description: „Jetzt neu starten“ opens the same tabs again.

source_url.description: Own update source: a `latest.json` URL or a folder; blank = GitHub.

auto_summary.description: Summarize with the configured AI right after the transcription.

input_device.description: Name of the input device (`""` = the system default).

keep_audio.description: Keep the audio file once the transcript is written.

shortcut.description: Global shortcut that starts or stops a recording (`""` = off).

source_url.description: Admin source tried before the defaults: an `https://` address or a folder (UNC share, mounted drive, `file://`) holding the model files under their usual names. `""` = none.

system_audio.description: Windows: record the system audio too (WASAPI loopback), e.g. the other side of a call.

Widget.description: A widget on a board: its place in the grid (`x`, `w` in columns of [`GRID_COLUMNS`], `y`, `h` in rows) and its own settings (their shape belongs to the UI).

id.description: Stable id within the board (keys, the text of a „Notiz“).

kind.description: One of [`WIDGET_KINDS`] or a kind the UI registers (see [`valid_widget_kind`]); kinds of another shape are dropped by [`Dashboard::normalized`].

title.description: Own title instead of the widget's name.

WidgetSize.description: Width of a widget of the start page before 1.6: one, two or all four columns.

oneOf.description: Unknown sizes (e.g. from a newer version) fall back to medium.

ai.description: KI: tools the assistant may use, chat history, streaming, cost limit.

appearance.description: Darstellung: themes, accent, fonts, density, window backdrop.

assistant_instructions.description: Extra instructions appended to the assistant's system prompt.

auto_route.description: Route by prompt complexity; when off, `router.standard_model` is always used.

auto_update_check.description: Look for a new release at start and every few hours (only in builds with an update key). Updates are never installed without the user's click.

backup_dir.description: Folder for automatic backups; `None` = `backups` in the data folder.

backup_keep.description: Number of backups kept; older ones are deleted.

backup_targets.description: Further folders that receive a copy of every backup (network shares, cloud folders).

briefing.description: Morgen-Briefing: when it shows up and its sections.

calendar.description: Calendar sync: Outlook, ICS files and subscriptions (subscription URLs live in the credential store).

capture.description: Quick capture: default target, inbox page, „Auswahl übernehmen“, auto-hide.

capture_shortcut.description: Global shortcut for the quick-capture window, e.g. `Ctrl+Shift+Space`.

close_to_tray.description: Closing the main window hides it to the tray instead of quitting.

daily_target_hours.description: Target working hours per workday; days below it are flagged in the timesheet.

daily_template.description: Template page for new daily notes; `None` = built-in sections.

dashboard.description: Widgets of the start page (and of new tabs).

dev_log_json.description: Developer log: also write the events as JSON lines (`logs/annalo.jsonl`).

dev_log_level.description: Developer log level (`error` … `trace`); empty: `dev_log_verbose` decides (debug or info).

dev_log_verbose.description: Developer log (Settings → Protokoll): also write debug lines (AI requests, syncs, backups).

editor.description: Editor: autosave, tab size, spell checking, toolbar, link previews.

embedding_model.description: Embedding model for semantic search; `None` = keyword search only.

embedding_provider.description: Provider of the embedding model; `""` = the first provider.

filing.description: Ordner & Ablage: folder and granularity per page type, rules.

git_sync.description: Push the Markdown mirror to a Git remote (the access token lives in the credential store).

idle_threshold_minutes.description: Pauses longer than this are offered for subtraction when a timer stops.

jira.description: Jira sites, saved JQL searches and the sync (tokens live in the credential store).

keymap.description: In-app shortcuts that differ from the defaults: command id → `Ctrl+Shift+D` (`""` = off).

litellm_base_url.description: Root URL of the LiteLLM proxy, e.g. `https://llm.example.com`. Kept in step with the address of the provider [`LEGACY_ID`] for older versions and scripts (see [`Settings::sync_legacy`]).

locale.description: Sprache: language, date and number format.

mail.description: „E-Mail als Aufgabe / Notiz“: parent of mail notes, global shortcut, attachment default.

markdown_mirror.description: After every backup, write the workspace as Markdown files (+ time entries as CSV).

markdown_mirror_dir.description: Folder of the Markdown mirror; `None` = `markdown` in the backup folder.

network.description: Proxy, extra root CA and timeouts (the proxy password lives in the credential store).

notes.description: Notizen: daily notes, trash and version history.

notifications.description: Benachrichtigungen: which reminders show, quiet hours.

onboarding.description: First-run intro and setup: which intro was completed and when (kept by `settings_save`).

open_daily_on_start.description: Open today's daily note on start.

palette_shortcut.description: Global shortcut that brings up the command palette, e.g. `Ctrl+Shift+K`; `None` or `""` = off (the default: Ctrl+K works inside the app).

pernr.description: SAP personnel number for CATS exports.

prices.description: Prices per 1M tokens for providers that do not report costs (LiteLLM does; local providers are free).

privacy.description: Datenschutz: what the AI may read, local-only mode.

providers.description: AI providers in order of preference; keys live in the credential store, one per id.

quick_links.description: Links at the top of the sidebar (web pages, tools, folders).

search_shortcut.description: Global shortcut of the quick-search window (Spotlight-like), e.g. `Ctrl+Shift+O`; `""` = off.

start.description: Start: what opens at start, window restore, start minimized.

thresholds.description: Budget warning and critical levels (share of the budget used).

time.description: Zeiterfassung: on/off, rounding, CATS export, balance.

updates.description: Update mode, own source, interval and session restore (Settings → Über; an organization's policy can override them, see `update_policy`).

version.description: Version of the stored shape (see [`crate::settings_migrate`]); settings without one are from 1.9 or older. A newer version's number is kept.

voice.description: Sprachnotizen: Whisper model and its source, language, input device, summary, audio.

workdays.description: Workdays as ISO weekday numbers (1 = Monday … 7 = Sunday).

workspace_scopes.description: Sections this workspace decided for itself or shares with every workspace on this computer (see [`crate::settings_layers`]); sections not listed follow their default.
